paints.name: Rockfall
paints.note: The back passage is buried under the fall.

paints.name: Three passages
paints.note: The long passage straight ahead is the way north.

paints.name: Split level and stream
paints.note: The ramp climbs over the stream to the upper ledge and the way east.

paints.name: Edge of the fungal grove
paints.note: The grove has grown over the right-hand passage.

paints.name: Toward the Darklake
paints.note: Black water runs out of the back passage.

paints.name: Chasm and natural bridge
paints.note: The stone bridge is the only dry way over.

paints.name: The faceless statue
paints.note: The way north runs through the statue's lap.
